release_scope: Basic usable sidebar, tactical timeline and integrated LLM failure-attribution panel are required; stable gameplay has priority and later versions deepen these features.

sidebar.waiting_behavior: Show actual request state and elapsed time; do not fabricate model reasoning.
sidebar.layout_preference: 低威胁时尽量对称美观，防守和阶段目标优先

tactical_timeline.segmentation_basis: Observed battle events and sustained state/action changes; no fixed-minute boundaries.
tactical_timeline.click_behavior: Inspect evidence/history without changing live gameplay or control mode.

3: Check sidebar space when measuring game window
6-8: Preserve timestamped evidence and action sources for failure reviews
9-12: Pass phase-dependent priorities into LLM input
Record active goal, public summary, and actual action results
Link request timing, public decisions, validation and execution results for attribution
18-20: Semantic segmentation, evidence navigation, replay integration
Failure attribution panel, video keyframes and verified timeline links
21: Failure review regression including missing logs, partial video and unverified outcomes
22-26: Review user-provided failed-run videos, prioritize fixes and retest with evidence

failure_attribution.input: User-provided failed-run video; runtime logs optional
failure_attribution.analysis_provider: LLM integrated into the software; chat-only manual analysis does not fulfill final scope
failure_attribution.evidence_policy: Video-only analysis is supported. Internal system causes need matching logs or explicit hypothesis/unresolved labels. Preserve original video and SHA256; do not invent decisions, inputs or certain counterfactual wins.
failure_attribution.timeline_linking: Link video timestamps and keyframes; align runtime IDs only with verified clock anchors, preserving offset and uncertainty.
failure_attribution.missing_link_policy: Nullable links; never fabricate runtime IDs
